Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3-6 months for the first 3 years, every 6-12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Regular surveillance for breast cancer recurrence is essential, including evaluation with a cancer-related history and physical examination.
Annual mammography is recommended for the breast treated by breast-conserving surgery and the intact contralateral breast.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Only if high-risk criteria are met
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: MRI of the breast should be restricted to women who meet high-risk criteria, such as those with a BRCA1/BRCA2 mutation or a very strong family history of breast cancer.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Annually for postmenopausal women on SERMs
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Annual gynecologic assessments are recommended for postmenopausal women on selective estrogen receptor modulator therapies (SERMs) due to the increased risk of endometrial cancer.
